sentence: This project uses artificial intelligence to study how wheat genetics and field environments interact, so drought-tolerant wheat varieties can be developed faster.
This project develops peptide nucleic acid pieces that can recognize any sequence of double-stranded RNA.
This project studies how strong magnetic fields change the transfer of energy between intersecting laser beams.
This project studies how greenhouses and vertical indoor farms can grow crops with efficient use of resources.
This project sets up an instrument that measures stable isotopes of carbon and nitrogen in lake sediments, fossils and organic matter.
This project develops methods to measure and control how much AI models memorize in text-attributed graphs.
This project studies how phytoplankton respond to low amounts of engineered nanoparticles, including whether their growth speeds up.
This project builds computational tools that predict how long quantum bits keep their information and how it is read and transferred.
This project studies how much methane termites make and release, and how that relates to the microorganisms in their guts.
This project builds adaptive modular circuit metamaterials with sensing, energy harvesting and digital computation, and studies their thermal, mechanical and electrical behaviors.
This project develops ways to make quantum communication secure, simpler and more tolerant of noise, using both classical and quantum methods.
This project builds a cybersecurity program with courses on healthcare informatics and governance, risk and compliance.
This project builds a trapped ion platform with integrated photonics that is more portable, more stable and easier to scale.
This project studies how robustness and resilience shape the way organisms respond to stress.
This project builds a computing platform that combines processors, accelerators and memory as needed to solve problems that could not be solved before.
This project uses seismic data to study what drives aftershocks and to make detailed images of fault zone structures.
This project measures how turbulence behaves across different scales in a magnetized high energy density plasma created in a laboratory.
